_note: Design tokens (spec 7B.3), defined once for both themes and used everywhere. Colour-blind safety and contrast are checked by the automated tests.

cues.pattern: Solid fill for transmit, outlined with light fill for receive
cues.shape: Block in the upper half of the lane for TX, lower half for RX
cues.example: An A2DP data packet sent by the device.

cues.pattern: Solid fill for transmit, outlined with light fill for receive
cues.shape: Block in the upper half of the lane for TX, lower half for RX
cues.example: A video burst received from the access point.

cues.pattern: Diagonal edge lines on the band
cues.shape: Numbered marker at the top of the band
cues.where: Vertical band over the overlap time
cues.example: A Bluetooth packet and a Wi-Fi burst overlap on a shared antenna.

cues.shape: Small filled tick at the top right of the block
cues.example: Wi-Fi was granted over A2DP with one packet waiting.

cues.pattern: Diagonal strike line across the block
cues.shape: Red outline and a small cross
cues.example: A connection event denied outside its time slice.

cues.pattern: Dashed outline at the original time
cues.shape: Dashed arrow to the new position
cues.example: A2DP packet moved after a Wi-Fi burst.
A hop inside the Wi-Fi channel with low isolation.

cues.shape: Small open tick at the top right
cues.example: Both radios receiving at the same time.

cues.shape: Small circular arrow badge with the attempt number
cues.example: Second attempt of a denied connection event.
Bluetooth transmits near, but not inside, the Wi-Fi channel.

cues.shape: Grey cell in the channel map strip
cues.example: Channel 40 is not used after the map takes effect.

cues.shape: Dark outline, 2 px, with a soft glow
cues.example: The block whose explanation is open.
